theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ct_vs_diagonal_subseq
theorems.statement: ∀ (ι : Type) (F : ℕ → Set ι) (s : ι → ℕ → ℝ), (∀ (m : ℕ) (ψ : ℕ → ℕ), StrictMono ψ → ∃ θ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono θ ∧ ∀ i ∈ F m, ∃ c : ℝ, Tendsto (fun j => s i (ψ (θ j))) atTop (𝓝 c)) → ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ i ∈ F m, ∃ c : ℝ, Tendsto (fun j => s i (φ j)) atTop (𝓝 c)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
